title: Zelensky Says Trump Risks ‘Historic Mistake’ If He Backs Russia
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine pressed Sunday for more information on possible restrictions to Starshield, a U.S.-provided satellite internet service used by the Ukrainian military.
